newsitem.title: FRANCE: Elf Atochem buys Laporte's adhesives unit.
newsitem.headline: Elf Atochem buys Laporte's adhesives unit.

text.p: Elf Atochem, a unit of French energy company Elf Aquitaine, said on Thursday it has agreed to buy the European adhesives and sealants activities of Laporte Plc.

The activities represent turnover of 100 million stg and include Evode and Sovereign in Britain, Evode Industries in Ireland, Simson in the Netherlands and Hey'di in Germany, Elf Atochem said in a statement.
It gave no details on the acquisition price.
The acquisition is part of Elf Atochem's expansion strategy in speciality chemicals, the company said.
The operations will be integrated into AtoFindlay, a company set up in January 1996 after the acquisition of Findlay Adhesives of the United States.
The addition of the new activities will give AtoFindley 1997 turnover of three billion francs and consolidate its position as one of the world's leading adhesives manufacturers, the statement said.
